purpose: Canhão da muralha visto por trás, apontando para dentro do pátio da batalha com Grenfell.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new isolated GAME SPRITE of a small antique fortress CANNON for Bodega do Sadi, a detailed warm painterly pixel-art RPG seen from above at three-quarter perspective. Genuine transparent PNG alpha background. This is a precise REAR VIEW: the observer is behind the cannon, looking over its rounded CLOSED BREECH and rear cascabel knob toward the long barrel that extends AWAY from us, straight NORTH, toward the TOP edge of the image. The near closed breech is wider and nearer the BOTTOM; the distant barrel narrows toward the TOP. The muzzle opening faces AWAY from the observer and must NOT appear as a large black hole facing the camera. Camera looks downward about 45 degrees: visible top of barrel, top planks of the wooden carriage, upright sides of four small solid timber truck wheels with iron rims, wheels resting naturally on the invisible ground plane. This must be a genuinely drawn rear perspective, NOT a vertically flipped front view and NOT an upside-down cannon. Cast iron dark charcoal tube with subtle weathered warm-gray highlights and three reinforcement bands, worn honey-brown oak naval-style box carriage with iron fittings, two smaller far wheels and two slightly larger near wheels, a small wooden aiming wedge beneath the closed breech. No tall spoked field-gun wheels. Clear readable silhouette at 70 pixels wide, restrained texture, crisp dark brown contours and stepped pixel clusters, warm upper-left lighting matching the existing stone fort and coastal props. Barrel centered on the vertical axis; left and right carriage sides balanced. A gentle rear three-quarter TOP DOWN view, no dramatic perspective or exaggerated foreshortening. Show the full cannon, wheels, barrel and knob, centered with generous transparent margins; no muzzle flashes, smoke, soldiers, cannonballs, ground, plinth, wall, scene, text, border, grid, watermarks or shadow outside the object. Maintain the detailed stylized pixel-art aesthetic of the existing fortress props, no glossy 3D rendering.
